text: Used for shop items that do not affect plans

Steal-Take Masterplans steal Treasury, Warpstone and/or Food from the target region. Higher-income settlements yield greater rewards, but carry a higher risk of [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_red_token]][[/img]]Complications.
Great-Smart Masterplans unlock gradually throughout the campaign and provide unique effects – such as summoning a Verminlord.

Kill-Stab Masterplans secretly build an army beneath the target region. This army can only attack that region and has no recruitment or upkeep costs, but you have limited control over its unit composition.
